svg.aria-label: Ak&Ven use case diagram, detailed version. Customer connects to Browse Catalog, Manage Cart, Negotiate Price, Checkout, and Authenticate. Negotiate Price includes Generate Negotiation Response (AI Negotiation Agent) and Validate Discount, and is extended by Propose Bundle. Checkout includes Process Payment (Payment Provider) and is extended by Create Account. Staff connects to Authenticate, Manage Catalog, and Review Negotiation Transcripts. Admin generalizes Staff, inheriting its use cases, and additionally connects to View Audit Log, Manage Users, and Set Margin Floor. Manage Catalog is extended by Set Margin Floor and includes Record Audit Entry. Manage Users also includes Record Audit Entry.
